title: Dalaran
body: Dalaran, the city of the Kirin Tor, hangs in the sky above Crystalsong Forest. For years it stood behind a violet dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake, rebuilt after the Burning Legion tore it down; faced with the blue dragonflight and the Scourge, the mages lifted the whole city and carried it to Northrend. Rhonin leads them, and its streets are open to Alliance and Horde alike, though each keeps a guarded quarter of its own.

parts.body: With a gap found in the defenses of Icecrown Citadel, envoys of Jaina Proudmoore and Sylvanas Windrunner look for fighters in the city's streets.

title: The Violet Citadel
body: The Violet Citadel is the inner fortress of the Kirin Tor and the seat of their leader, where Rhonin keeps counsel with Vereesa Windrunner, Archmage Aethas Sunreaver and Archmage Modera. Its shelves keep the city's memory: the journal of Antonidas records his study of the plague of the north and his choice of Jaina Proudmoore to seek its source.

title: Rhonin
body: Rhonin is the leader of the Kirin Tor, a human archmage who welcomes visitors from the great hall of the Violet Citadel. Years ago, as a young mage on a desperate mission into Khaz Modan, he helped free the Dragonqueen Alexstrasza from Grim Batol, and on that journey met the ranger Vereesa Windrunner, now his wife and the mother of his twin sons. Under him the Kirin Tor carried Dalaran north to face the blue dragonflight and the Scourge.

title: Vereesa Windrunner
body: Vereesa Windrunner is the Ranger General of the Silver Covenant and the youngest of the Windrunner sisters, after Alleria and Sylvanas. Once a ranger of Quel'Thalas, she guided a young Rhonin and fought beside him at Grim Batol, and she is now his wife. When blood elves sought a place among the Kirin Tor, she gathered the high elves who would not accept them into the Silver Covenant, which has joined the Alliance in Northrend.

parts.body: Seeing Quel'Delar restored moved her beyond words: the day it was lost, when Thalorien Dawnseeker and King Anasterian fell, she counts among the darkest she has known.

title: Aethas Sunreaver
body: Archmage Aethas Sunreaver is a blood elf of the Kirin Tor and the champion of his people in Dalaran. The Horde was long barred from the city, and it was through his efforts that it was accepted at all; his followers have taken up his name as the Sunreavers. The high elves of the Silver Covenant reject the admission of blood elves into the Kirin Tor outright, and Aethas stands beside Rhonin in the Violet Citadel all the same.

parts.body: To him the restored Quel'Delar's return mirrors the rise of the sin'dorei from defeat and betrayal, and the blade is already adapting itself to its bearer.

title: Antonidas Memorial
body: The Antonidas Memorial is a park in northern Dalaran where a statue of Archmage Antonidas, Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, rises above the lawns, its plaque dedicated by his apprentice Jaina Proudmoore: the city stands once more, a testament to the will of its greatest son. Volumes left around the city tell how he warned that the plague of the north was magical, how King Terenas refused his quarantine, and how Arthas broke his wards and slew him.

title: The Eventide
body: The Eventide is a square in southern Dalaran around an enchanted fountain. Over the years many coins have been tossed into it, and patient hooks bring them up again, each still carrying its owner's wish: Antonidas asking for the strength to accept what he could not change, Jaina begging Arthas to come back to her, Krasus swearing to free his kin in Grim Batol, Khadgar hoping Turalyon and Alleria are well.

title: The Underbelly
body: The Underbelly, the sewer beneath Dalaran, is the city's slum and the haunt of its disreputable types. Rogues run a black market, a tavern serves them with a warning to watch their backs, and the Steamwheedle Cartel runs an arena circuit in the central sewers, its dueling rings at the Circle of Wills. A pipe drops out of the bottom of the city, safe only for those who can fly.

title: Krasus' Landing
body: Krasus' Landing, at the eastern edge of Dalaran, is where riders on the wing come and go, named for Krasus, long a friend of the Kirin Tor. A high elf teaches riders to fly in the cold northern skies, and officers of the gunships Skybreaker and Orgrim's Hammer wait on the landing with Alliance marines and Kor'kron reavers, ready to carry volunteers to the war above Icecrown.

parts.body: A valiant of the Argent Tournament waits here to pay the passage of anyone who has yet to find the way north to the tournament grounds.
